notes: v0.19.12 (code 64): Allow the existing official signed in-app updater to run before license acceptance on Quest and Android phones, so future license-screen bugs can be recovered without uninstalling or clearing app data. The license screen now offers Check for Updates alongside Agree & Continue and Decline & Exit; a missing/unreadable agreement screen also exposes Check for Updates. Only the internal non-exported MobileUpdaterActivity is exempted from license gating. Update recovery does not accept the agreement or grant staff access, and existing signature verification, SHA-256 verification and owner-controlled GitHub feed are unchanged. After closing the updater, users still must explicitly accept the agreement before using other Companion features. Preserve the main Tracking tab Full logging guide, Quest SAF Documents/Logs permissions and Quest Tools, phone Shizuku and floater, OSC, staff authorization, Relay and GM1-only invite authority. The comprehensive proprietary license rewrite remains unpublished; no app-data reset or Main Launcher/Relay deployment.
